added_failures_note: The reviewed run recorded no baseline_suite or after_suite (both blank in its manifest), so it carries no two-arm suite delta of its own. Its gate was the per-arm runner at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py, whose log runner-heuristic.log ends EXIT=0, plus the record's containment verdict and the runner's own containment self-check that fires on planted inputs; the change touches only docs/evidence paths that no test module covers, so the added-failure set is empty rather than unmeasured by a suite that could have exercised it.

findings.text: follow-on: the field cost_limit_passed_usd holds the 1.98 ceiling, not a pass/fail, so a reader comparing spend (0.360652) against it compares a spend to a cap stored under a name that asserts a verdict; the value is copied verbatim from docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:508, which sets it to min(apply_cap(planned_calls), ARM_BUDGET_USD), and the landing fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-camera-width-heuristic-r2.html:35 quotes the unrelated USD 2.00 arm ceiling rather than this effective cap.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to run the heuristic arm of the angular_width_of_camera anchor family in a scratch graph through the per-arm runner; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/angular_width_of_camera-heuristic.json:8 records arm heuristic with anchor toroidal_angular_width_of_camera and outcome_status complete at line 168.
item_verdicts.manifest: read in full; status complete, two commits (bf9ecaa75, 2e3eaeb05), changed_paths and test_logs present, negative_control_log declared as none with its reason, blockers none.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief's Write scope names the arm JSON, the landing HTML and a figures directory; the diff touches only the arm JSON and the landing HTML, both inside those declared paths.

justifications.durability: the diff adds no assertion at all -- it is a data record and a doc -- so nothing committed reddens if the record's scores or containment verdict were later replaced, and the only guard is the runner's post-apply containment gate at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:617.
justifications.evidence: every done_when item is recorded and independently checkable -- ledger calls 11 (angular_width_of_camera-heuristic.json:10) reconcile with the four per-model call counts at lines 171,176,181,186 summing to 11, and spend_usd 0.360652 at line 224 with their sum -- but no pytest arm ran, so the added-failure delta is an empty set rather than a suite result.
justifications.fit: the record follows the ab-record JSON idiom of its siblings in ssog-anchor-ab/ and the landing HTML follows the evidence-fragment idiom at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-aperture-jev.html:1, though angular_width_of_camera-heuristic.json:31 carries a field name that asserts a verdict its value does not hold.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/angular_width_of_camera-heuristic.json:8 records arm heuristic at anchor toroidal_angular_width_of_camera with outcome_status complete at line 168, the deliverable the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition of its own and forks no capability -- the record is produced by the existing runner docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:399 run_arm, which delegates to harmonize.plan_family_applies and graph.temp_neo4j.
